name: hive-monorepo
description: Hive suite controller: installs and manages the Hive:Magnus products from signed release manifests.
author: ChefTaco

scripts.bootstrap: npm --prefix services/hive-registry ci && npm run hooks:install
scripts.test: npm run test:ci && npm run test:install-scripts && npm run check:release-docs && npm run test:registry && npm run test:suite
